question: What did Nexus Consulting propose to client Kova d.o.o. regarding ERP integration?
expected_answer: Nexus proposed implementing SAP S/4HANA 2023 to replace Kova's existing Microsoft Dynamics NAV 2016. The proposal included modules FI/CO, MM, SD, and AA, integration with Magento 2 via a custom Python middleware, and integration with Manhattan Associates WMS. The project value was 217,300 EUR and the original proposed go-live was October 1, 2024.

question: Which projects involved cloud migration and what were the key lessons learned across those projects?
expected_answer: Two projects involved cloud migration: (1) Atlas d.o.o. (AWS, eu-central-1) and (2) Argon d.o.o. (Azure, West Europe). Key lessons learned from both, documented in the cloud migration lessons report: (1) Lift & shift is often the right decision for time-constrained projects; (2) Terraform is mandatory from day one; (3) A proper workload assessment before migration saves time (Azure Migrate was accurate to ±10% for Argon); (4) Multi-AZ for all production databases is non-negotiable; (5) Exchange to M365 migration is more complex than expected — should be treated as a separate subproject; (6) Cut-over should be on Saturday morning, not Friday evening; (7) For Windows workloads, Azure is preferable; for Linux workloads, AWS is more cost-effective.

question: Which projects exceeded their original timeline and what were the reasons?
expected_answer: Multiple projects experienced delays: (1) Atlas cloud migration — original go-live was Q2 2024 (June), revised to December 2024. Reasons: complexity of .NET Framework 4.5 legacy services and WAF approval delays. (2) Kova ERP — original go-live was October 1, 2024, revised to Q1 2025 (January/February). Reasons: poor data quality in NAV (data cleaning extended from 3-4 weeks to 6 weeks) and architecture change (custom middleware instead of SAP Integration Suite). (3) Nova Logistics CRM — original go-live was June 2023, actual was September 11, 2023. Reason: poor quality of Excel data files from sales team. (4) Meridian — 1-2 weeks behind plan at mid-project review.
